features: 1.96" AMOLED Always-On Display: 600 nits of peak brightness and an always-lit screen, so time and stats stay readable from the morning commute to the noon sun.
Noise AI Pro Suite: One suite where AI Transcription types your meetings, AI Voice Commands get things done, AI Playground designs your watch face and AI Companion answers your health questions.
AI Transcription: Meetings, calls and passing ideas convert to text in real time, so every decision is captured the moment it's spoken.
Noise Productivity Suite: Morning Briefs to start the day informed, Super Notifications for OTPs and updates at a glance, and Noise Vault to keep tickets and QRs on the wrist.
Functional Crown and Shortcut Button: Turn to scroll, press to select, and keep your most-used feature one click away on the custom button.
